elements.description: Get the CrazyGames SDK environment. SDK functionality should only be used when the result is "local" or "crazygames".
elements.name: crazygames.get_environment

elements.description: Get the current CrazyGames game settings, including muteAudio and disableChat.
elements.name: crazygames.get_game_settings

returnvalues.doc: The current settings table, or nil if settings are unavailable.
returnvalues.name: table

elements.description: Register a listener that is called whenever the CrazyGames game settings change. Registering again replaces the previous listener.
elements.name: crazygames.add_settings_change_listener

parameters.doc: The function takes two arguments, self and the updated settings table.
parameters.name: callback

elements.description: Remove the currently registered game-settings listener.
elements.name: crazygames.remove_settings_change_listener

elements.description: The gameplayStart() function has to be called whenever the player starts playing or resumes playing after a break (menu/loading/achievement screen, game paused, etc.)
elements.name: crazygames.gameplay_start

elements.description: The gameplayStop() function has to be called on every game break (entering a menu, switching level, pausing the game, ...) don't forget to call gameplayStart() when the gameplay resumes
elements.name: crazygames.gameplay_stop

elements.description: The loadingStart() function has to be called whenever you start loading your game.
elements.name: crazygames.loading_start

elements.description: The loadingStop() function has to be called when the loading is complete and eventually the gameplay starts.
elements.name: crazygames.loading_stop

elements.description: Celebrate a major player achievement, such as beating a boss or reaching a high score.
elements.name: crazygames.happytime

elements.description: Report the player's current game-completion percentage to CrazyGames. The value must be between 0 and 100.
elements.name: crazygames.report_game_completed_percentage

elements.description: Attach JSON-serializable game state to feedback submitted by the player. Call clear_game_context when the state is no longer relevant.
elements.name: crazygames.set_game_context

elements.description: Clear the game context previously supplied with set_game_context.
elements.name: crazygames.clear_game_context

elements.description: Show a rewarded ad.
elements.name: crazygames.show_rewarded_ad

elements.description: Show a midgame ad.
elements.name: crazygames.show_midgame_ad

elements.description: Detect if the user has an adblocker.
elements.name: crazygames.has_ad_block

parameters.doc: The function takes two arguments, self and a boolean indicating whether an adblocker was detected.
parameters.name: callback

elements.description: Request a banner. The container will be resized to the specified width.
elements.name: crazygames.request_banner

elements.description: The responsive banners feature will request ads that fit into your container, without the need to specify or select a size beforehand.
elements.name: crazygames.request_responsive_banner

elements.description: Clear a banner. Will also hide it.
elements.name: crazygames.clear_banner

elements.description: Clear all banners.
elements.name: crazygames.clear_all_banners

elements.description: Create a link to your game to invite others to join a multiplayer game.
elements.name: crazygames.invite_link

elements.description: Display a button in the game footer that opens a popup containing an invite link. This CrazyGames feature is deprecated in favor of Room Data, but remains available for existing integrations.
elements.name: crazygames.show_invite_button

elements.description: Hide the invite button when it is no longer necessary.
elements.name: crazygames.hide_invite_button

elements.description: Get an invite link parameter.
elements.name: crazygames.get_invite_param

returnvalues.doc: The parameter value, or nil if the parameter is missing.
returnvalues.name: string

elements.description: Get all invite parameters supplied when the game was opened from an invite link.
elements.name: crazygames.get_invite_params

returnvalues.doc: The invite parameters, or nil if the game was not opened from an invite link.
returnvalues.name: table

elements.description: For multiplayer games, if is_instant_multiplayer() returns true, you should instantly create a new room/lobby for the user.
elements.name: crazygames.is_instant_multiplayer

elements.description: Update the current multiplayer room. The table can contain roomId (string), isJoinable (boolean), and inviteParams (a table of string, number, or boolean values). Only supplied fields are updated.
elements.name: crazygames.update_room

elements.description: Notify CrazyGames that the player has left the current multiplayer room.
elements.name: crazygames.left_room

elements.description: Register a listener for requests to join a multiplayer room. Registering again replaces the previous listener.
elements.name: crazygames.add_join_room_listener

parameters.doc: The function takes two arguments, self and the invite parameters table.
parameters.name: callback

elements.description: Remove the currently registered join-room listener.
elements.name: crazygames.remove_join_room_listener

elements.description: Remove all stored game data from the CrazyGames data module.
elements.name: crazygames.clear_data

elements.description: Get a stored value from the CrazyGames data module.
elements.name: crazygames.get_item

returnvalues.doc: The stored value, or nil if the key does not exist.
returnvalues.name: string

elements.description: Remove a stored value from the CrazyGames data module.
elements.name: crazygames.remove_item

elements.description: Store a value in the CrazyGames data module.
elements.name: crazygames.set_item

elements.description: Get information about the user's locale, country, device, operating system, browser, and CrazyGames application type.
elements.name: crazygames.get_system_info

returnvalues.doc: The current system information, or nil if it is unavailable.
returnvalues.name: table

elements.description: Retrieve one page of the current user's CrazyGames friends. Only one list_friends request may be active at a time. The callback receives nil if the request fails.
elements.name: crazygames.list_friends

parameters.doc: Number of friends to retrieve, between 1 and 50.
parameters.name: size

parameters.doc: The function takes two arguments, self and the friends-page table.
parameters.name: callback

elements.description: Before using any user account features, you should always ensure that the user account system is available.
elements.name: crazygames.is_user_account_available

elements.description: Retrieve the user currently logged in CrazyGames. If the user is not logged in CrazyGames, the callback receives nil. Will call the provided callback with the logged in user account.
elements.name: crazygames.get_user

parameters.doc: The function takes two arguments, self and the user table
parameters.name: callback

elements.description: The user token is in JWT format and contains the userId of the player that is currently logged in to CrazyGames, as well as other useful information. You should send it to your server when required, and verify/decode it there to extract the userId. Will call the provided callback with the token.
elements.name: crazygames.get_user_token

parameters.doc: The function takes two arguments, self and the token
parameters.name: callback

elements.description: Generates a custom Xsolla token that you use with the Xsolla SDK. Will call the provided callback with the token.
elements.name: crazygames.get_xsolla_user_token

parameters.doc: The function takes two arguments, self and the xsolla token
parameters.name: callback

elements.description: By calling this method, the log in or register popup will be displayed on CrazyGames. The user can log in their existing account, or create a new account. Will call the provided callback on log in.
elements.name: crazygames.show_auth_prompt

parameters.doc: The function takes two arguments, self and the user table
parameters.name: callback

elements.description: You can register a user auth listener that is triggered when the player logs in to CrazyGames. A log out doesn't trigger the auth listener, since the entire page is refreshed when the player logs out.
elements.name: crazygames.set_auth_listener

parameters.doc: The function takes two arguments, self and the user table
parameters.name: callback

elements.description: Remove any previously set auth listener.
elements.name: crazygames.remove_auth_listener

elements.description: Show an account linking prompt to link a CrazyGames account to the in-game account. Will call the provided callback with a response table containing either response = "yes" or response = "no". The response is nil if the prompt fails.
elements.name: crazygames.show_account_link_prompt

parameters.doc: The function takes two arguments, self and the response table
parameters.name: callback

info.description: Functions and constants for interacting with the CrazyGames SDK APIs
info.name: extension-crazygames
